Performed by: Ustad Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan (Qawwal & Party)
Original: Oriental Star Agencies Ltd on YouTube (youtube.com/watch?v=H6ff2pnxUn0)
All rights belong to the artists and the original publisher. Shared with love and full credit, for the Mehfil. Listen to the complete qawwali on the original channel. 🤍

The remembrance of the Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) makes the whole garden bloom, the mehfil glows, and his blessed name tastes so sweet. A seeker in a night garden, a mehfil of ordinary people, and the blessed name in gold calligraphy. (The Prophet is never drawn.)
